title: Audit device code flow sign-ins before you block it
summary: Who and what still authenticates with the device code flow, so you can scope exclusions before a block-device-code Conditional Access policy.
code:
union SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where AuthenticationProtocol == "deviceCode"
| summarize SignIns = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 5)
    by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName
| order by SignIns desc
notes: Expect shared devices such as Teams Rooms and some CLI tools. Put real exceptions in a dedicated group that the block policy excludes.
